pages.title: The 3-Layer System
pages.text: You choose three layers, in order — and the middle one is permanent.$(br2)$(bold)1. Origin$() — your species. Flavor powers like flight, wall-climbing, or fire immunity. 13 options: $(l:icraft:classes/origins_reference)The 13 Origins$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)2. Race$() — your people. Stat modifiers and thematic traits. 11 options. $(warn)Permanent.$()$(br2)$(bold)3. Class$() — your combat role. 10 options, respec-able at a Class Altar.

pages.title: What to Pick If...
pages.text: $(bold)Want to hit things:$()$(br)$(thing)Berserker$() (axes, low-HP rage), $(thing)Samurai$() (katanas + bows), $(thing)Orc$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to cast spells:$()$(br)$(thing)Archmage$() (pure magic, glass cannon), $(thing)Battlemage$() (melee+magic), $(thing)Faefolk$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to tank:$()$(br)$(thing)Vanguard$() (pure tank, -15% damage), $(thing)Paladin$() (tank+support+heals), $(thing)Dwarf$() race

pages.title: What to Pick If... (2)
pages.text: $(bold)Want to explore:$()$(br)$(thing)Wanderer$() (jack of all trades), $(thing)Ranger$() (fast, mobile), $(thing)Elf$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to build/craft:$()$(br)$(thing)Artificer$() class, $(thing)Dwarf$() or $(thing)Halfling$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to summon:$()$(br)$(thing)Void Summoner$() class, $(thing)Revenant$() race$(br2)$(bold)Don't know yet:$()$(br)$(thing)Wanderer$() class + $(thing)Human$() race. No penalties, bonus XP. Respec your class later once you know your playstyle.

pages.title: Proven Combos
pages.text: $(bold)Blazeborn + Dwarf + Berserker$()$(br)Fire synergy. Nether becomes trivial.$(br2)$(bold)Elytrian + Elf + Ranger$()$(br)Maximum mobility. Fly, kite, never get hit.$(br2)$(bold)Enderian + Faefolk + Archmage$()$(br)Teleport, spell from range, glass nuke.$(br2)$(bold)Witch of Ink + Orc + Berserker$()$(br)Weak early, monster late. Hyperscaling melee.$(br2)$(italic)Remember: Race is permanent. Class can be changed. When in doubt: Human + Wanderer.$()

pages.title: Getting Started with Magic
pages.text: Magic is available from $(t1)Tier 1$():$(br2)$(bold)Iron's Spells & Spellbooks$() — Craft a Copper Spell Book early (this pack ships $(l:icraft:mods_t1/modular_spells)Modular variants$(/l) that take upgrade pages). Find spell scrolls in dungeon chests and inscribe them to learn spells.$(br2)$(bold)Botania$() — Also $(t1)Tier 1$(). Mana flowers, mana pools, botanical tools.$(br2)$(bold)Ars Nouveau$() — $(t2)Tier 2$(). Custom spell crafting with glyphs.

pages.title: Getting Your First Gear
pages.text: $(bold)Apotheosis Affixes$() — Mob drops roll random affixes and gem sockets. Kill $(thing)Champions$() (glowing mobs) for the best early gear.$(br2)$(bold)Tetra Workbench$() — Craft one to customize weapons and tools, swapping handles, blades, and guards by material.$(br2)$(bold)Food Diversity$() — Spice of Life pays permanent max-HP bonuses for eating widely. Free health — collect food as you loot.$(br2)$(bold)Next: read $(l:icraft:welcome/three_commands)The Three Commands$(/l).$()
